name: Waze Travel Time
description: Drive times from Home Assistant's Waze Travel Time sensors in the NBA / NFL / NHL Live arcade style: a status-coloured row per destination (CLEAR, BUSY, HEAVY, JAM) with the delay against free flow, a congestion meter, a trend arrow and the minutes in big digits. A route turning heavy triggers a burst. A dead sensor shows NO DATA / NO WAZE instead of a stuck Loading screen.
author: ant456

versions.notes: Arcade redesign. Reads the sensor state as the minutes (older HA: the duration attribute). Honest NO DATA / OFFLINE screens, free-flow memory, traffic alerts, non-blocking refresh.
